blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and the Supreme Court signed an agreement on Wednesday to establish a centralized database of foreign divorce laws, a move aimed at making it easier and less costly for Filipinos to seek recognition of divorces obtained abroad.
